# daily-email-bot

> A free bot that emails you at 7 AM and 7 PM with an AI summary of what you changed in your code and what's left on your goals list.

If a person shared this repository with you, read the AI guide first.

## Start here
- [AI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/daily-email-bot/main/AGENTS.md): what it is, what to ask, setup steps, how to use it
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/daily-email-bot/main/README.md)
- [Full setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/daily-email-bot/main/README.md)
